## Summary

I resolved ticket T-5003 by investigating the payout-sender pod in the treasury namespace. The pod logs revealed that all payouts have been failing since May 19 at 14:30 UTC with a 403 Forbidden error from Northbridge Pay, indicating the request origin IP (34.201.17.88) is not on the allowlist for merchant MRC-20931. Since the treasury ops team manages the Northbridge merchant portal settings and engineering has no access, they need to add this IP address to the allowlist to resume payment processing.
